text: A 5-year visa? That's a new one.... I have heard bad stories about the Jerusalem branch. But generally, when you hear a clerk deviate from policy then you may need to ask to see a manager or be a little persistent in asserting your rights - i.e., ask them to show you where in the procedure it says what they are claiming. But yes, as others say - Holon branch is often better, also Petah Tikvah.
